entities.name: Wenceslaus III of Bohemia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wenceslaus III was King of Hungary and Croatia from 1301 to 1305, and King of Bohemia and Poland from 1305. He was the son of Wenceslaus II, King of Bohemia, and Judith of Habsburg.
